Hymn 256: As Zion's Youth in Latter Days
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Susan Evans McCloud
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 256 titled "As Zion's Youth in Latter Days" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Susan Evans McCloud.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
